title: Unsupported actions/first-interaction runtime
summary: This release predates the action's Node.js 24 runtime. GitHub no longer provides Node.js 20 on Actions runners.

sources.title: Node 20 is no longer available in GitHub Actions

constraints: Preserve the welcome messages and the token inputs when upgrading; v3 renamed some inputs, so compare them with the release notes.

steps.title: Upgrade first-interaction
steps.instructions: Change the uses reference to actions/first-interaction@v3 or a later supported major.

steps.title: Review first-interaction inputs
steps.instructions: Compare configured inputs with the target release and update renamed or changed options; confirm the runner meets the release's minimum version.
